balls.text: full-toss on off stump, opens out and swipes it to long-on
full and wide, driven straight to extra cover
very full outside off, goes deep in his crease and swats it towards long-off
full and wide, driven firmly to the left of long-off
length ball on off stump. Pandya opens up and looks to flat-bat it down the ground, ends up edging it towards third man
another full-toss, width again, and he slaps it to the right of sweeper cover. Russell slides to make the stop at the boundary. What's more, it's also a no-ball. He's overstepped by a long way there
full-toss wide outside off. This is terrible bowling from Umesh, and Pandya simply flashes at it to carve it over point
slower yorker, angled into the batsman's feet. Swipes at it and it rolls down towards long-on
very full outside off, and Pandya doesn't have much swinging room there. Goes hard at it and jabs it back to the bowler
short ball, but this sits up at waist height, and that is such a stylish way to bring up a half-century. Swivels into a pull and dumps it high over the midwicket boundary
quick bouncer and Pandya's a little late on the hook, and the top-edge flies over the keeper for another four
fuller now, outside off, it's a slower ball and Pandya slices under it to get it over the gap between short cover and mid-off
beamer from Russell, slips out of his hand and goes over Pandya's left shoulder. He keeps his eye on the ball and attempts a late swat/hook at it, but doesn't connect
shortish on off stump, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket

sees him looking to come forward and fires it flat down the leg side. It's a wide, but there's a stumping appeal from Uthappa. Pandya did overbalance a touch, but I think his foot came down just in time to save himself
tossed up on leg stump, and Pandya clears his front leg and launches it easily over the wide long-on boundary. Used his bottom-hand to scoop it up and over
fuller now, outside off. Pollard goes deep in his crease to dab it towards short third man
goes on the back foot looking to make room to hit through the off side. Turns in sharply and tucks him up for room and he punches it away towards sweeper cover
back of a length, carrom ball, punched to sweeper cover
down the track now, hits it in the air, with the turn, doesn't quite get hold of it, and it drops just short of Suryakumar, diving in from long-on
fuller now, on off stump, driven firmly down the ground and the bowler's right foot gets in the way. If not inadvertently, certainly not entirely advertently
short ball outside off, sits up again, and that's another boundary. Pandya stands tall and plays a flashing cut that races to the point boundary
short ball but this skids through quick and Pandya is late on his pull, inside-edges it past his leg stump and down to the fine leg boundary
low full-toss wide outside off, and he opens his bat face to slice it to the left of third man. Narine slides and gets his body behind the ball but only ends up pushing it into the rope
slower ball, short, on off stump, and Pandya swivels through his hips and pulls to find the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket. Super shot, but that ball just sat up for him
fullish on off stump, whipped to long-on
tossed up slowish outside off. Pollard stretches out and pokes it to backward point
a bit of turn now, on that offbreak, cramps Pandya for room as he goes on the back foot. Plays with a straight bat, punches to long-off
shortish outside off. Pollard lets it come on and picks up a dabbed single to short third man
length ball outside off, turns away. Pandya goes on the back foot and taps it gently towards backward point
another wide down the leg side. I think he's expecting the batsman to come down the track, in the back of his mind
back of a length on off stump, turns away and Pollard dabs it delicately to the right of the keeper
flatter and straighter now, but the offbreak turns down the leg side
down the track now and Narine provides him the perfect ball in his hitting zone. It's flighted and it's outside off, giving him swinging room to launch that over long-on
low full-toss on off and middle. Pollard moves away from the line and jabs it down to long-on
slower ball, back of a length on off stump, blocked back to the bowler
short on off stump, pulled to deep square leg
shortish ball on off stump. Gets his front foot in the air to play a short-arm jab-whip to the left of short fine leg
slower length ball outside off, and Pandya shoulders arms
back of a length on off stump, no room at all, but Pandya doesn't need it. Simply waits there, lets it come close to him, and just jabs it backward of point and sends it racing away to the boundary
flat, angled across Pollard. Not short enough to cut and it skids quickly past his bat
tossed up a bit slower, angled into off stump. Pandya is on the front foot to push into the covers
goes extremely round-arm now, and the angle takes the ball down the leg side
fuller now, still quite flat and quick. Drags it from outside off to drive towards long-on
back of a length outside off, whipped to long-on
flat and shortish on off stump, stops on the pitch and Pollard can only club it to long-on
flat, angling into the pads. Pollard, back in his crease, can't connect with the flick
slower short ball and Pollard is through his pull too quick, drags it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
shortish ball angling in towards off stump, skids through quickly and goes between bat and body as the batsman tries to work it into the leg side
on the pads now, tucked away to deep square leg
slower bouncer outside off, and Pollard gets into an uncomfortable position to play a half-pull, half-whip that just eludes short fine leg, running to his left
back of a length on off stump, shuffles across to tuck it into the vacant infield on the leg side. Picks up two by the time deep midwicket runs in to field it
shortish outside off. Pandya hops in the air to ride the bounce and steer it to third man
slow, angled in towards middle and leg. Comes forward to work it leg side and it turns in and hits him on the pad and rolls away towards square leg
length ball on middle stump, poked back to the bowler off the back foot

opened him up! That was a beauty from Narine. Pitches middle, hits off, and Rohit clearly didn't pick it. Was looking to go on the back foot and work it through the leg side, initially, and then tried to adjust and play with a straight bat, but it slipped quickly past his bat-face and clipped his off bail

short outside off and it turns away to offer even more width. Rohit cuts it away and Chawla, sprinting to his left from sweeper cover, got to the ball but got into a terrible position as he tried to bend and stop it, ended up letting it through between his legs
goes back to a length ball on off stump, not much turn, whips it away to deep midwicket
tossed up slow and full on middle stump, worked away to deep midwicket
shortish outside off, gets off the ground to push it towards point

short ball on off stump and this time Pollard shows some attacking intent, goes deep in his crease and swings his torso quickly through a powerful pull, beats deep square leg easily even though he didn't have too much distance to cover to his left
back of a length outside off, poked straight to backward point
full and wide and Pollard misses out. It was there to drive but he hits it straight to cover
shortish, angling into the body, and Rohit leans backwards at the waist and lets it come on and run off the face of his bat to the left of third man
shortish ball close to off stump. Pollard stands tall and drops it into the off side with soft hands to pick up a single
flighted delivery outside off and Rohit gets a lovely stride out to play an utterly orthodox drive to the extra cover boundary. Long-off had no chance of stopping that
down the track and this time he gets to the pitch of the leg-stump ball to drive to long-on
off the mark now, off the outside edge. Prods forward to defend this floaty ball outside off. It goes with the angle and pops off the edge towards backward point, who fumbles to allow a second

0 off 9 now as he sees him coming out of his crease and bowls it slower and wider. He reaches out to prod it into the off side. Sets off for a single but turns back in a hurry as short cover swoops on the ball
tossed up outside off, another offbreak, and Pollard presses forward to push it back to the bowler. 0 off 8.
offbreak turning from off to middle. Rohit goes on the back foot to work it towards midwicket
there's the skidder and Pollard is stuck on the back foot. It hurries on to hit him on the pads before he can bring his bat down but the lbw appeal is turned down. Was going down leg, probably
again he goes back to a length ball, this time it's on off stump and he punches it to sweeper cover
a bit of air, on off stump. Rohit is down on one knee quickly to sweep it to the square leg boundary
slow again, but just a bit of width, and though it isn't too short, Rohit has all the time in the world to rock back and cut it firmly to the left of point
nice and slow this time, on middle and off, and he comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler
starts with a full ball angling into leg stump. Rohit presses forward and clips towards midwicket
lots of bounce again from a not particularly short length. Pollard is on the front foot but his hands are high as he pokes it away into the covers
shuffles down the pitch now and Morkel shortens his length again. Pollard defends with nice soft hands
back of a length, angling into the body. Tries to move across and leave, it hits his body and rolls towards square leg
shortish, looking to angle into the body. Overdoes the angle and it slips down the leg side
back of a length outside off, a lot of bounce. Gets his hands up high to defend into the off side
length ball on middle and leg and he's a touch too early to close his bat face to flick, and it goes off the leading edge towards third man
length ball on middle stump. Rohit stays on the back foot and defends into the on side
down the track now and Shakib fires it in flat on the pads. Can't get his bat round to play the flick
slowish, angled in but still finishing wide of off stump - that's what the low arm can do - and he comes forward to block and it bounces to hit his gloves
length ball on off stump. Rohit goes on the back foot to whip to long-on
sees Rayudu skip down the track and bowls it slower and wider. He goes through with the shot but ends up slicing it high and not quite getting the distance, finds Russell at wide long-off
tossed up on middle and leg, clipped to mid-on
tossed up outside off, pushed to sweeper cover
full on the pads and Rayudu clips it elegantly to the left of short fine leg
back of a length outside off, dabbed away to third man
short and a fair way outside off. Rohit leaves it alone, and the umpire signals wide. Looked pretty close to the tramline.

excellent riposte, this. Simmons makes room this time and Morkel bangs it in, gets a lot of bounce. Simmons wasn't in a great position to uppercut that, and ended up scooping it feebly into short third man's hands
slower ball on off stump, and he sits deep in his crease to swat that high and dump it over the long-on boundary
down the track, giving himself room. Morkel spears in the yorker that he jams away towards backward point. Morkel's overstepped, and he'll have to deliver a free hit
not short enough to pull, angling into the body as well. Simmons isn't in a very good position and ends up inside-edging into his body
back of a length on off stump, Rohit lets it come on and guides it towards third man
tossed up slower outside off, driven to long-off
short now, and it sits up on an off-stump line, and Rohit jumps back, makes just a bit of room, and cuts hard on the top of the bounce to beat point to his right
pulls his length back just a touch as Rohit takes a big stride forward, defends into the on side
full, angling in towards off stump. Rohit looks to drive through cover, the angle ends up making him drive back to the bowler

and that's a typical end to a typical Parthiv innings. Runs down the track again but fails to reach the pitch. May have wanted to hit straight down the ground, ends up flicking it uppishly, straight down the throat of deep midwicket
down the track first ball, and Shakib gives him too much swinging room, slanting a flat, full ball across the left-hander. He swings through the line and hits it cleanly to the left of mid-off
on the pads, and Simmons has missed out there, flicking crisply but straight to short fine leg
slower ball outside off. Simmons makes room to try and carve through the off side, misses

dropped! The ball is following Umesh here. Parthiv pulled a shortish ball from a fair way outside off, using his wrists to play the shot in the direction he wanted. He wanted to get it wide of short fine leg, but it was close enough to him to dive to his right and get a hand to it, but it didn't stick
on the pads now and he tucks it away to the right of Umesh at short fine leg
down the track comes Parthiv, making room all the time, and he carves the full, wide ball over the covers, slicing under it and hitting crisply
slower ball on middle stump, nudged with soft hands into the on side, and they pick up two by the time mid-on and square leg converge on the ball
full and wide, and Simmons drives with a full, unfettered follow-through to pierce the gap between point and cover
fuller and straighter, swept to deep square leg
another shortish ball outside off and it doesn't quite come on. Parthiv drags the flat-bat slap to cover
slanted across Parthiv, and it's a touch short and there's width too. Parthiv slaps but can't beat cover
angled into the pads again, clipped towards midwicket
sees Simmons skipping down the pitch and fires it into his pads. Rolls off the front pad towards Uthappa, who fumbles. Not sure if there was a stumping opportunity there. Oh, there certainly was.
back of a length on off stump, whipped wristily to deep square leg
back of a length close to off stump. Parthiv rides the bounce and drops the ball into the covers with soft hands
straighter now, on off and middle, and Simmons, who was initially backing away towards the leg side, swipes it to mid-on, not quite middling it
length ball again, a touch closer to off stump this time. Simmons leans back and tries to slap it square on the off side, it doesn't quite come on and he drags it to short extra cover
length ball outside off, fifth-stump line, lots of bounce. Simmons pokes at it away from his body, ball bounces over his angled bat
length ball on off stump, pushed with a nice straight bat towards mid-off
length ball on off and middle, tucked away towards deep square leg

back of a length outside off, dabbed away to the right of point, and Morkel, chasing to his left from third man and sliding, makes an absolute hash of the stop. Pulls it back with his left hand, and it hits his right arm and rolls into the rope
length ball angling across towards off stump, defended into the covers
shot. That's nice and full outside off and Simmons gets a big stride forward to play a firm drive into the ground. Bounces over short cover, who jumps in the air to palm it away
straighter this time, Simmons' head falls over as he tries to work that across his front pad, doesn't make contact. Got his pad outside the line, I think. No appeal from the bowler
length ball outside off, a bit of shape away. Left alone

and another slower ball, and another swing and miss. He came down the track this time, but again the angle across him, and the lack of pace, defeated his across-the-line swish. What a final over from Pollard
and again, this one's a bit wider and he swings across the line and only makes contact with air
this time he gets the slower ball right, it's just outside off, and Chawla swings and misses
goes for the slower ball angled across Chawla, overdoes the angle, and it ends up waay outside off stump
shortish slower ball on off stump, swiped towards midwicket

oh my. That was terrible fielding from Malinga. It was a slower ball on middle and leg, and Umesh slogged at it and sent it running away to the left of short fine leg. He dived to his left, ended up falling over the ball, and it ran away for four

and he strikes first ball! It's a slower short ball on off stump. Yusuf goes for the pull, top-edges it, and the ball balloons into Parthiv's gloves. This could be a decisive twist. The batsmen didn't run, didn't cross over.
another slower offcutter. This one was back of a length on off stump, and Chawla played and missed again, trying to dab it down to third man with half a bat
this time he gets the off-stump yorker right and he can only jab it firmly into the ground and send it bouncing over the bowler's head
fullish on off stump. He errs on the shorter side while going for the yorker, and it ends up as a full ball that he hoicks away, with the angle, over the midwicket boundary to bring up his fifty
and again, a slower offcutter that Chawla swings at and misses. Bounces down to Parthiv, and he fumbles it, allowing them to sneak a bye
lovely. Slower ball, full and angling across. Chawla swings at it, looking to carve over the covers, and the ball sneaks past his bat
yorker on middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket

shortish, sits up at waist height, and that is superb fielding from Rayudu, sprinting to his right from deep square leg and sliding to stop that crisply timed pull from Yusuf. Made the stop look so easy
back of a length ball on off stump. Stays in his crease and dabs it softly into the off side for a quick single
short again, angling into the body. Yusuf swivels, pulls between long leg and deep square leg
short again, this time it's close enough to Yusuf to uppercut with great use of his wrists and clear the desperately leaping fielder at short third man
slower bouncer angled across Yusuf, who leans backwards to try and ramp it but cannot connect

that's his favourite pick-up shot, that's effortlessly timed, and that's hit straight into deep midwicket's hands! It was full on the pads, and he flicked it with an almost casual air. Shot was on, I suppose. He may have been looking to hit it a lot squarer than he ended up doing.
full outside off, goes deep in his crease but still can't get under it, hits it low and firm to mid-off
full-toss on off stump, whipped to long-on
length ball, wide outside off again, and that's excellent from Suryakumar, comes forward and slices under it to get it up and over point. Excellent use of the hands
shortish, a lot of width, and he simply waited on it and dabbed it late and dabbed it to the right of the keeper. Terrible delivery with third man in the circle, and a clever shot to exploit it
full and wide now, slapped down to long-off
short and wide and Yusuf stands tall to flat-bat that powerfully to the left of wide mid-off. Pressure on Vinay early in the over
low, outswinging full-toss on off stump, and he clips it with a closed face and just clears the leaping Pandya at midwicket

slower ball wide outside off and he's dismissed Russell! It was just short of driving length, and the low arm caused it to angle away from the batsman a bit. Went for the big hit, on one knee, looking to go over long-on, and ended up edging it to the keeper
short ball, is onto Yusuf too quick to pull, and he's lucky the top-edge fell in no-man's land, a long way to the left of and in front of short fine leg
bouncer now, and Yusuf sways away from the line

full on off stump and that is a super shot from Pathan. A jabbing punch with a straight bat, front leg out of the way, the umpire ducks to get under it and neither Pollard - sliding from long-on - or Suchith - sprinting from long-off - could get to it
slower ball, full and wide, steered towards sweeper cover with an open face
slower ball, full and wide outside off, driven towards extra cover
yorker on middle stump, and Russell flicks to short fine leg
slower short ball wide outside off. Yusuf reaches out and plays a checked uppercut to land it short of the sweeper cover fielder
short and wide, slapped to the right of sweeper cover
short ball, dug in sharply, and it's too close to him to pull with any authority, and it balloons in the air, straight into the hands of Pandya running in from deep midwicket

length ball on leg and middle, clears his front leg and whip-pulls to deep square leg and takes on Rayudu's arm. They take two, the throw's a little wide of the stumps, Parthiv has to stretch to collect, and Shakib dives home
low full-toss outside off, sliced away to sweeper cover
shortish ball and this time Shakib really gets hold of the pull, clears his front leg and his bat makes a resounding sound to send it flying to the forward square leg boundary
full and wide, and he juuust goes past the tramline outside off
slower ball on leg stump, tucked away towards short fine leg

slower bouncer, angled across Yusuf, who stands there and leaves it outside off. Umpire signals wide, much to the bowler's bewilderment. Side-on replay shows it climbed over head height, so it was a fair call
shortish again, pulled towards deep square leg
slower ball, angling into the body. Is too early into the pull and it hits him on the back of his hip and rolls to the keeper
short ball to start the spell, pulled away to deep midwicket
down the track now, can't beat mid-off. He made room to punch the length ball with a straight bat, but he hit it straight to the fielder
slogged, and he's just cleared midwicket. Back of a length ball angling across him, and he cleared his front leg to swipe it across the line. Didn't really middle it
shortish slower ball on off stump, whipped away to deep midwicket
short and wide again, this time it stops on the pitch and he hits it to sweeper cover
length ball now, on middle stump. Opens up his hips and swipes it away towards deep square leg
shot. Poor ball from Pandya, short and wide, and he splits the gap between point and third man with his square cut
down the track again, meets the ball with a straight bat to drive to long-on
flat, angling in towards middle and leg. Goes back and across and nudges it into the on side
down the track to a loopy, dipping ball on off stump, drives it to long-on
goes on the back foot to a length ball outside off, enough width for him to slash hard and slice away, off the outside half of the bat, to the left of the fielder at slip
tossed up full on off stump, Shakib pokes it into the covers
length ball outside off. Yusuf stays in his crease and pushes it with soft hands into the off side for a quick single
and he's gone! Down the track again, and Suchith bowls it flat and quick and yorks him and takes out his leg stump

chipped, straight to deep midwicket, straight out. That was a dolly for Pandya. This time Gambhir got too close to the pitch of the ball and ended up flicking rather than swinging at the ball, and the ball went straight to Pandya, at chest height, and it simply spilled out of his cupped palms
down the track again, and that is super stuff from Gambhir, shovels it from an off-stump line, with the turn, and finds the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
length ball outside off, stays on the back foot and punches towards deep cover
tossed up wide outside off and that's a gift for Yusuf, gets down on one knee and launches it high over long-off
down the track and hits with the turn, in the air but on the bounce to deep midwicket
uppish from Gambhir, looking to slash at a length ball by making room. Ends up slicing it in the air to the right of point but it bounces short of him as he dives to try and catch it
nice change of pace, slow and dipping onto a good length on off stump. Gambhir comes forward to defend
back of a length outside off, dabbed towards short third man

excellent work from Parthiv, runs forward and dives to catch the ball near where silly point may have stood, but the ball popped off Yusuf's front pad and nothing else. Missed a sweep at a quicker one
tossed up fuller, on off stump, worked away wristily through midwicket after taking a big stride forward
slowish, width outside off, turns away to give Gambhir even more room, and he goes on the back foot and cuts at the top of the bounce to find the boundary at point
back of a length on off stump, makes a bit of room and plays that typically surgical chop down to third man
down the leg side now, I don't know how much bat Yusuf got on that sweep, rolls down to short fine leg
is that a drop? Naah. It's fuller and Yusuf makes room to hit inside-out, over the top. Doesn't carry to Pollard, diving to his left from long-off, and rolls away for four
back of a length on off stump, turns away sharply and bounces to beat Yusuf, who goes on the back foot and looks to punch him through cover
down the track, whips it from off stump towards deep midwicket
angles it across towards off and middle. Gambhir goes back and across to work it with the turn into the leg side
length ball on off and middle, defended back to the bowler
fullish on off stump, defended towards short extra cover
again the angle takes the ball down the leg side, and Yusuf doesn't connect with the sweep
back of a length outside off, chopped to short third man
length ball turning from off to leg, with a lot of inward angle too. Defended towards short midwicket
tossed up outside off, driven to long-off
tossed up full on off stump, driven to long-on
slowish ball angled in from wide of the crease, ends up slipping a fair way down the leg side
length ball on off stump, defended towards short cover and they run a quick single
back of a length outside off, dabbed to third man
bouncer, banged in from around the wicket, and it hurries through and Gambhir sways away from the line and belatedly attempts an unsuccessful pull
back of a length on off stump, pushed towards mid-off
back of a length, tucking Yusuf up for room, defended to short extra cover
back of a length, angling into the body, tucked away towards backward square leg
slip in place and he bowls what looks like a doosra outside off. It certainly left the batsman, but it gave him plenty of room to lean back and cut to the backward point boundary

risky single, direct hit, and I think Pandey's gone here. It was fired in quick and full, and Gambhir used the angle to tickle it towards short fine leg. Pandey made the call for the single, but realised he had to dive to make his ground, and even so the direct hit from Simmons caught him a foot short of the crease
tossed up on middle stump, whipped to deep midwicket

juggle, juggle, gone. This must have been a plan, judging by how often Harbhajan was angling these darts in towards leg stump. Too quick for Uthappa to get down on his knee and sweep, and he ends up lapping uppishly from a semi-crouched position, and hits it straight to Malinga at short fine leg, at chest height. He didn't catch it cleanly on first attempt, but managed to grab onto it
goes on the back foot, leans towards the leg side, dabs the length ball to short third man
flat, fired down the leg side. Uthappa can't connect with the sweep
and there's Uthappa. It's a length ball, angled in towards middle stump, and Uthappa uses the angle, gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps powerfully over the square leg boundary
short, skiddy ball. Uthappa is a bit late on the pull, rolls towards backward square leg

shortish ball rising towards the ribcage. Gambhir hops to dab it down in front of him for a quick single. McClenaghan is quick to the ball and tries to slap it onto the stumps at the keeper's end while sprawled on the ground, doesn't hit them
sharp bouncer that Gambhir sways away from. Parthiv is at full-stretch to stop that behind the stumps
angled in towards off stump, on a length. Uthappa makes room and slaps to point and takes off for a quick single. May have been close had Suchith's throw hit at the bowler's end
full and wide, driven to short extra cover
back of a length on middle stump and Uthappa clears his front leg and just about clears a leaping midwicket with his front-foot pull
back of a length on off stump. Gambhir lets it come on and dabs it to third man
length ball on off stump, punched back with a perfectly straight bat and Vinay dives to his right to stop it
short ball now and that's a release ball for Uthappa, who smacks the pull to the left of deep midwicket. They're checking if it carried all the way, and it hasn't. It's yorked the boundary cushions
down the track, another slog across the line, and the ball is an offcutter, beats the inside edge and just misses the top of off stump
length ball on off stump, Uthappa slogs across the line, ends up hitting it off the inside half of the bat, rolls to midwicket
angled into off and middle, tucked away towards deep backward square leg
gives Gambhir width first up as he steps down the track. Slices it uppishly, but very firmly, to the left of Suchith at cover point. Dives full length but can't reach it
shortish on off stump. Back and across to defend towards point
another slower ball, dips towards the front boot, and he flicks it away to deep square leg
another slower full-toss outside off, dips under Gambhir's bat as he shapes uncertainly to drive
too full, too straight, and that's clipped off the toes, to the right of square leg, and it screams away to the boundary
back of a length on off stump, whipped away through square leg and they run two by the time long leg can sprint across to field it
slower ball on off stump, comes forward and clips it through midwicket
fuller now, on off stump. Gambhir stays inside the line and slices at the ball, hits it straight to cover
back of a length outside off. Tries to make room and carve it through point again, doesn't make contact
shortish, just enough width for Gambhir to stand up tall and crash it away to the right of the diving cover fielder
length ball angling in towards off stump. Gambhir is stuck on the crease, and he ends up blocking it into the on side
shortish on middle and leg, pulled towards deep square leg
back of a length, angling across towards off stump, defended towards point
slower full-toss outside off, defended to mid-off
length ball on off stump. Uthappa gets his front foot across to tuck it towards wide mid-on
dipping slower ball, ends up as a low full-toss just outside off. Uthappa defends back towards the bowler. A bit of outswing on that as well
length ball outside off. Positive stride forward to push to cover
full, angling down the leg side, and Uthappa flicks it up and over the leg side, sends the ball rolling away to the midwicket boundary
back of a length outside off. Uthappa is on the front foot to steer it down to third man
